items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: If it was what we called traditional jazz, I was on it. There was Edmond Hall on clarinet, where there was Albert Nicholas with Sidney Bechet

ctx.x: Well, by that, I mean once they discovered that they could have me, and that they wanted me, then they started -- I was the staff pianist, so to speak. That didn't mean they owed me so much work. Every time they had a

date I was on piano, for the most part, if it was that kind of date. If it was what we called traditional jazz, I was on it. There was Edmond Hall on clarinet, where there was Albert Nicholas with Sidney Bechet or whether it was Sidney Bechet, or whether it was the Chicagoans, with Rod Cless, whatever it was. Or a New Orleans -- I can't name all the clarinet players.
